text:
Maria G: Heads up — QA flagged that when we flip the new alert routing policy the console shows two alert owners for the same SLO. Can someone confirm this is a UI dedupe issue or a backend fanout problem?
Sachin: I saw that too in staging. Appears only on SLOs with per-tenant overrides + global fallback. The notify payload has both owners in it. :thinking_face:
Alex P: If the payload contains both, the routing layer might be not pruning fallthroughs. Quick check: which rule IDs?
Maria G: Example payload snippet from staging: 
```json
{"slo_id":"svc-123:latency_p95","rules":[{"id":"r1","owner":"team-a"},{"id":"r2","owner":"oncall-platform","fallthrough":true}]}
```
Tess (eng-sre): That explains the UI. Console expects a flattened owner field and currently reads the first owner only. But the fanout engine sends both to downstream notifiers. Need to decide canonical ownership for display and for who gets pages.
Sachin: Ops policy: pages should only go to the first matching owner unless flagged for escalation. We should avoid double paging. Can we add a fanout filter? :thumbsup:
Alex P: Two implementation options: (1) Filter at routing — drop fallback owners for paging but keep them for history/telemetry, or (2) change console to show combined owners but mark which is primary. (1) is safer and simpler.
Maria G: I'm leaning (1). But we need to be careful about quota accounting — if we drop owners we might undercount notify cost for tenant billing.
Tess (eng-sre): Proposal: routing filter with a telemetry flag. Notify messages to pagers are pruned; a copy with full owner list goes to telemetry queue only. That keeps billing/metrics intact.
Sachin: Sounds good. Quick question for rollout: how will this affect canary tenants currently on per-tenant overrides?
Alex P: We'll add a feature-flagged routing toggle. Canary group gets filtering=true. We'll monitor the metric `notify.fanout.pruned_count` and `pager.invocations` drop.
Maria G: UX ask — console should show both (primary + fallthrough) but annotate which one will be paged. E.g., "Primary: team-a; Fallthrough: oncall-platform (no page)"
Tess (eng-sre): Agree. I'll add a short line to the runbook and add a graph in the alerting dashboard for pruned_count.
Sachin: I'll drop a small PR to routing with the flag and tests. Want to ship this behind FF by EOD if no objections.
Alex P: :ok_hand: One nit — ensure the telemetry copy is async and non-blocking so we don't add latency to notify path.
ops-bot: deploy-preview: routing-service/pr-532 ready for staging -> https://staging.deploy/532 :rocket:
Maria G: Great, thanks everyone. Follow-up: can someone update the console API contract so the UI doesn't break when a consumer expects a single owner string?"
